text:
Ari (CS): FYI escalated: Acme reported their free trial credits disappeared from acme-prod and showed up on a newly created acme-sandbox clone. Customer says this happened after an SSO re-link.
AcmeCorp Admin: yep, we restored SSO yesterday and noticed credits on the clone right after. acme-prod now shows 0 credits.
Ari (CS): Thanks. Can you paste the org/workspace IDs? I want to check grant records and any recent provisioning events.
AcmeCorp Admin: org_0a1b2c3d workspace_prod: ws_prod_9f8e workspace_clone: ws_clone_ab12
Riley (Support-Lead): tagging @Devon @Sofia — possible mapping mismatch during SSO sync or SCIM?
Devon (Eng): On it. First guess: SSO restore created a new workspace with a different internal id and the promo grant linked by external_email or user mapping instead of canonical org id. Can you share the grant id from billing portal?
AcmeCorp Admin: grant_2026_trial_72
Devon (Eng): Thanks. I'm checking ledger. I see grant_2026_trial_72 attached to ws_clone_ab12 at 2026-02-28T21:03:12Z. Original ws_prod_9f8e had the grant applied earlier but it shows revoked at the same timestamp.
Sofia (SRE): Also looking at audit logs for SSO restore. I see a provisioning event: scim.create workspace ws_clone_ab12 by user_id u-555 (SSO restore). The SCIM patch included externalId=acme.sso and primary_owner email aliased (admin+1). Our de-dupe rule matched on externalId but not on the old internal id.
Ari (CS): Short term: can Billing Bot manually reassign grant to ws_prod_9f8e? Customer needs credits back today.
Billing Bot: Received reassign request. Validating grant ownership and policy... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Billing Bot: Reassign allowed. Grant grant_2026_trial_72 moved from ws_clone_ab12 -> ws_prod_9f8e. New balance updated on 2026-02-29T02:12:04Z.
AcmeCorp Admin: Confirmed credits reflected in acme-prod now, thank you! :tada:
Devon (Eng): Root cause summary: SSO restore generated clone workspace with different internal id; SCIM/provisioning used an external alias which matched, but our grant resolution logic preferred the most recently provisioned workspace when multiple externalId matches exist. Edge case.
Devon (Eng): Fix plan: 1) patch grant resolution to prefer canonical org id when present, 2) add a safeguard that prevents auto-attachment of billing grants to newly created workspaces within 24h of provisioning, 3) add a reconciliation job to detect rapid reassignments.
Riley (Support-Lead): Timeline?
Devon (Eng): Quick fix (reconciliation script + guardrails) within 3 days. Patch to resolution logic in 2 sprints with QA. Will follow up with PR and rollout notes.
Sofia (SRE): Also added an alert to detect unusual grant moves: >1 billing grant reassigned for same org within 1h.
Ari (CS): I informed customer of the reassign and the engineering plan. Marking resolved for now, will reopen if they see any residuals.
AcmeCorp Admin: Thanks everyone — smooth. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Ari (CS): closing thread. If anyone wants the audit traces I can paste sanitized logs here.
